_comment: T-26 Model 1931 - PT-1 / TOP sight card. Three ladders side by side, one per ammunition type. The tank currently carries two rounds, so two are declared; adding a third shell is a third entry here with Side CENTER and no code change. Ladders are declared for shells that actually exist rather than padded to three, because an empty scale is a scale a player will try to aim with.
_optics: Mask / CommanderMask / Furniture are OPTIONAL. The aperture and every reticle line are drawn from geometry, so no art is required. If you add a PNG later, name it here and it is layered over the drawn mask; a path that does not resolve is skipped rather than painting the missing-texture magenta.
